hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.html|*.js) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && npm run --silent check:syntax >/tmp/claude-syntax-check.log 2>&1 || { echo "npm run check:syntax failed after editing $f:" >&2; tail -n 40 /tmp/claude-syntax-check.log >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; }
